title: LTR giveback/MFE counted price action from BEFORE the entry fill: two fresh ml_entry real-money trades closed 5 min after entry on a phantom +1.25R peak
note: MEASURED 2026-11-26 by Manager 26a (journal trades 8617-8620, order_packages): ml_entry ADAUSDT short (pkg-000be1cf79924370) and XRPUSDT short (pkg-6f152b3e407e4b64) on bybit_2 + bybit_portfolio ENTERED 16:04:14Z (first ml_entry trades since 11-24) and were CLOSED 16:09:55Z/16:10:27Z by live_review_close. The giveback wake at 16:05Z said ADA 'gave back 1.25R of 1.25R peak', XRP 1.28R of 1.30R. Arithmetic: ADA package_entry 0.1482, SL 0.15024 -> 1R 0.00204; the 15:00-16:00Z 1h bar low 0.1457 (closed BEFORE entry) = 1.23R, i.e. the 'peak' is pre-entry price. packet chart.since_entry and previous_review were null. Result: two fresh trades closed ~flat (bybit_2 venue pnl ADA -0.15, XRP -0.08 USD, fees) on false evidence; the judgement_cadence slot also fired on packages <1 min old. Fix: (1) MFE/peak/giveback computed only from prices after the entry FILL time (sub-bar data or bars starting after fill); (2) packet since_entry must be measured, and a giveback trigger with since_entry could_not_look does not fire; (3) REVIEWER-BRIEF: an action justified by in-trade excursion requires since_entry measured; (4) audit past live_review_close/tighten rows for the same artefact (how many trades were closed on pre-entry peaks). Revert path n/a (correctness fix). Operator decision, 2026-11-26 popup, verbatim: "Build a re-entry action" (question: reopen the two ml_entry shorts closed in error at 16:10Z; there is no manual entry path). Plan: ML-PRIMARY builds a narrow reopen-package-closed-in-error system action (original package SL/TP, current price, each account own RiskManager, venue read-back), shipped together with the minimal giveback fix (peak from post-fill prices only; no giveback trigger when since_entry is could_not_look) so the reopened trades cannot be killed by the same artefact; the past-close audit follows. Manager 26a 16:43Z: fix PR #29238 (Tier 2, held, head 009643a685, operator line). Root cause (ML-PRIMARY, from order_packages): meta.entry_time = decision-bar OPEN (15:00Z) while packages were created 16:03:54Z/16:04:09Z; exit_levers.since_entry keeps the bar containing entry_time, so position_telemetry counted the pre-entry 15:00Z bar as the trade. Fix: peak window = bars opened at/after the fill anchor (latest of created_at/opened_at/fill keys/entry_time), no anchor = unanchored; new_peak/giveback fire only when peak_state measured; judgement_cadence skips packages younger than one bar; REVIEWER-BRIEF step 0. Reopened packages carry entry_time 16:23:31Z, residual exposure = the 16:00Z bar's pre-fill minutes; reviewers held until deploy. Next: audit (C). Audit (C) by ML-PRIMARY, pushed to #29238 (d085d5761e; scripts/research/ltr_phantom_peak_audit.py, docs/research/ltr-phantom-peak-audit-2026-11-26/). Population: 88 close/tighten_sl/partial_close review rows 10-27..11-26; 56 measured, 32 could_not_look (31 are 15m legs whose candle window does not reach the fill, 1 unreadable package). Contaminated (seen peak exceeds true post-fill peak by >= 0.25R): 4, all ml_entry, all applied on bybit_2 + bybit_portfolio: 11-20 ADA long (seen 1.84R vs true 0.48R; original bracket later hit SL), 11-22 XRP short (0.15R vs -0.62R; later hit SL), 11-26 ADA and XRP shorts (reopened). Hindsight outcome of the two older ones: -2.03R forfeited (gross), i.e. the bad closes happened to help; luck, not evidence. Open: the 31 15m could_not_look rows remain unaudited (need a longer candle source). 2026-11-26 16:53Z ML-PRIMARY follow-up (owner ML-PRIMARY, not urgent): the audit's 31 could_not_look rows are 15m legs (ict_scalp_xrp_15m / ict_scalp_eth_15m, 10-27..11-05) whose /api/bot/candles 15m history (1000 bars ~10 days) does not reach the fill.
